        'enquiries.edit',
        'customers.index',

<?php

use App\Models\Agent;
use App\Models\AgentPic;
use App\Models\Bdn;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia;

test('guests are redirected from the agents page', function () {
    $this->get(route('agents.index'))->assertRedirect(route('login'));
});

test('index lists agents ordered by name', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    Agent::factory()->create(['name' => 'Zeta Agency']);
    Agent::factory()->create(['name' => 'Alpha Agency']);

    $this->get(route('agents.index'))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (AssertableInertia $page) => $page
            ->component('agents/index')
            ->has('agents', 2)
            ->where('agents.0.name', 'Alpha Agency')
            ->where('agents.1.name', 'Zeta Agency'));
});

test('store creates an agent', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $this->post(route('agents.store'), [
        'name' => 'Agent Smith',
        'address' => '1 Matrix Lane',
        'contact' => '0700000009',
        'mail_id' => 'agent.smith@matrix.test',
    ])->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect(Agent::sole())
        ->name->toBe('Agent Smith')
        ->address->toBe('1 Matrix Lane')
        ->contact->toBe('0700000009')
        ->mail_id->toBe('agent.smith@matrix.test');
});

test('store requires the core fields', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $this->post(route('agents.store'), [])
        ->assertSessionHasErrors(['name', 'address', 'contact']);
});

test('update saves edits to an agent', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $agent = Agent::factory()->create(['name' => 'Old Name']);

    $this->put(route('agents.update', $agent), [
        'name' => 'New Name',
        'address' => '2 Zion Way',
        'contact' => '0700000010',
        'mail_id' => 'new.name@zion.test',
    ])->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect($agent->refresh())
        ->name->toBe('New Name')
        ->address->toBe('2 Zion Way')
        ->contact->toBe('0700000010')
        ->mail_id->toBe('new.name@zion.test');
});

test('destroy deletes an agent and cascades its PICs', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $agent = Agent::factory()->create();
    $pic = AgentPic::factory()->create(['agent_id' => $agent->id]);

    $this->delete(route('agents.destroy', $agent))->assertRedirect();

    expect(Agent::find($agent->id))->toBeNull()
        ->and(AgentPic::find($pic->id))->toBeNull();
});

test('destroy is refused with an error toast when an order references the agent', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $agent = Agent::factory()->create();
    Order::factory()->create(['agent_id' => $agent->id]);

    $this->delete(route('agents.destroy', $agent))
        ->assertRedirect()
        ->assertSessionHas('toast.type', 'error');

    expect(Agent::find($agent->id))->not->toBeNull();
});

test('destroy is refused with an error toast when an order references one of the agent PICs', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $agent = Agent::factory()->create();
    $pic = AgentPic::factory()->create(['agent_id' => $agent->id]);
    Order::factory()->create(['agent_id' => null, 'agent_pic_id' => $pic->id]);

    $this->delete(route('agents.destroy', $agent))
        ->assertRedirect()
        ->assertSessionHas('toast.type', 'error');

    expect(Agent::find($agent->id))->not->toBeNull();
});

test('destroy is refused with an error toast when a bdn references the agent', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $agent = Agent::factory()->create();
    Bdn::factory()->create(['agent_id' => $agent->id]);

    $this->delete(route('agents.destroy', $agent))
        ->assertRedirect()
        ->assertSessionHas('toast.type', 'error');

    expect(Agent::find($agent->id))->not->toBeNull();
});

test('destroy is refused with an error toast when an order references the PIC', function () {

        ->assertRedirect()
        ->assertSessionHas('toast.type', 'error');

use App\Enums\BargeStatus;

test('guests are redirected from the barges page', function () {
    $this->get(route('barges.edit'))->assertRedirect(route('login'));
});

test('edit renders the barges page with status options', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    Barge::factory()->create(['name' => 'MT Bunker One']);

    $this->get(route('barges.edit'))
        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (AssertableInertia $page) => $page
            ->component('barges/edit')
            ->has('barges', 1)
            ->has('statusOptions'));
});

test('store creates a barge with a capacity per product', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $this->post(route('barges.store'), [
        'imo' => '9111222',
        'name' => 'MT New Barge',
        'vlsfo_capacity' => 3200.5,
        'mgo_capacity' => 800,
        'status' => BargeStatus::Available->value,

        ->imo->toBe('9111222')
        ->name->toBe('MT New Barge')
        ->vlsfo_capacity->toBe('3200.500')
        ->mgo_capacity->toBe('800.000')
        ->hsfo_capacity->toBeNull()
        ->status->toBe(BargeStatus::Available);
});

test('store validates required fields', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $this->post(route('barges.store'), [])
        ->assertSessionHasErrors(['imo', 'name', 'status'])
        ->assertSessionDoesntHaveErrors(['vlsfo_capacity', 'mgo_capacity', 'hsfo_capacity']);
});

test('update saves the barge', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $barge = Barge::factory()->create(['name' => 'Old Name']);

    $this->put(route('barges.update', $barge), [
        'imo' => $barge->imo,
        'name' => 'New Name',
        'hsfo_capacity' => 4000,
        'status' => BargeStatus::Maintenance->value,

    expect($barge->refresh())
        ->name->toBe('New Name')
        ->hsfo_capacity->toBe('4000.000')
        ->status->toBe(BargeStatus::Maintenance);
});

test('destroy deletes the barge', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $barge = Barge::factory()->create();

    $this->delete(route('barges.destroy', $barge))
        ->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect(Barge::count())->toBe(0);
});

test('destroy is refused with an error toast when an order references the barge', function () {

test('guests are redirected from the bdns page', function () {
    $this->get(route('bdns.index'))->assertRedirect(route('login'));
});

test('index lists bdns with their order, agent and barge details', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $agent = Agent::factory()->create(['name' => 'Blue Agents']);
    $barge = Barge::factory()->create(['name' => 'MT Bunker One']);
    $order = Order::factory()->create(['order_number' => 'ORD-BDN-INDEX']);
    Bdn::factory()->create([
        'order_id' => $order->id,
        'bdn_number' => 'BDN-INDEX-1',
        'agent_id' => $agent->id,
        'barge_id' => $barge->imo,

        ->assertOk()
        ->assertInertia(fn (AssertableInertia $page) => $page
            ->component('bdns/index')
            ->has('bdns', 1)
            ->where('bdns.0.bdn_number', 'BDN-INDEX-1')
            ->where('bdns.0.order_number', 'ORD-BDN-INDEX')
            ->where('bdns.0.agent_name', 'Blue Agents')

        'vlsfo_density_15' => 0.9814,

test('update edits the existing bdn in place rather than creating a second one', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $order = Order::factory()->create();
    $bdn = Bdn::factory()->create([
        'order_id' => $order->id,
        'bdn_number' => 'BDN-ORIGINAL',
        'pi_club' => 'Britannia',
    ]);

    $this->put(route('surveyor.bdn.update', $order), ['pi_club' => 'Gard'])
        ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect(Bdn::where('order_id', $order->id)->count())->toBe(1);
    expect($bdn->fresh())
        ->pi_club->toBe('Gard')
        ->bdn_number->toBe('BDN-ORIGINAL');

test('update mirrors the metric tons onto the order bdn quantities', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $order = Order::factory()->create();

    $this->put(route('surveyor.bdn.update', $order), [
        'vlsfo_metric_ton' => 480.125,
        'mgo_metric_ton' => 60.5,
    ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect($order->fresh())
        ->vlsfo_bdn_qty->toBe('480.125')
        ->mgo_bdn_qty->toBe('60.500')
        ->hsfo_bdn_qty->toBeNull();
});

    $order = Order::factory()->create([
        'status' => OrderStatus::Delivered,
        'vlsfo_rate' => 500,
        'mgo_rate' => 600,
        'hsfo_rate' => 0,
        'invoice_value' => 0,

    $this->put(route('surveyor.bdn.update', $order), [
        'vlsfo_metric_ton' => 100,
        'mgo_metric_ton' => 50,
    ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect((float) $order->fresh()->invoice_value)->toBe(80000.0);
});

test('update accepts a form where every field is still blank', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $order = Order::factory()->create();
    $blank = array_fill_keys((new Bdn)->getFillable(), '');
    unset($blank['order_id'], $blank['bdn_number']);

    $this->put(route('surveyor.bdn.update', $order), $blank)
        ->assertRedirect()
        ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect($order->bdn()->sole())

use App\Enums\OrderStatus;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\Order;

use Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia;

/**
 * An order with no value on any grade, so each test only sets what it cares about.
 *
 * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
 */
function creditManagementOrderFor(Customer $customer, array $attributes): Order
{
    $blank = ['invoice_value' => null, 'amount_received' => null];

    foreach (['vlsfo', 'mgo', 'hsfo'] as $grade) {
        $blank["{$grade}_rate"] = null;
        $blank["{$grade}_final_qty"] = null;
        $blank["{$grade}_quantity_high"] = null;
    }

    return Order::factory()->create([
        'customer_id' => $customer->sap_id,
        ...$blank,
        ...$attributes,
    ]);
}

});

test('index reports credit available and pending/open order counts', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $customer = Customer::factory()->create(['credit_limit' => 500000]);

    creditManagementOrderFor($customer, [
        'status' => OrderStatus::Pending,
        'vlsfo_rate' => 500,
        'vlsfo_quantity_high' => 200,

        ->assertInertia(fn (AssertableInertia $page) => $page

<?php

use App\Enums\EnquiryCustomerStatus;
use App\Enums\EnquiryStatus;
use App\Models\Customer;
use App\Models\Enquiry;
use App\Models\User;

test('store adds a customer to an enquiry', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $enquiry = Enquiry::factory()->create();
    $customer = Customer::factory()->create();

    $this->post(route('enquiries.customers.store', $enquiry), [
        'customer_id' => $customer->sap_id,
    ])->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect($enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->sole())
        ->customer_id->toBe($customer->sap_id)
        ->status->toBe(EnquiryCustomerStatus::Pending);
});

test('store rejects a customer already on the enquiry', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $enquiry = Enquiry::factory()->create();
    $customer = Customer::factory()->create();
    $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => $customer->sap_id]);

    $this->post(route('enquiries.customers.store', $enquiry), [
        'customer_id' => $customer->sap_id,
    ])->assertSessionHasErrors(['customer_id']);

    expect($enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->count())->toBe(1);
});

test('marking a customer fixed does not touch the others, and moves the enquiry to completing', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $enquiry = Enquiry::factory()->create(['status' => EnquiryStatus::Open]);
    $winner = $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => 'AAA']);
    $otherA = $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => 'BBB']);
    $otherB = $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => 'CCC']);

    $this->patch(route('enquiry-customers.update-status', $winner), [
        'status' => 'fixed',
    ])->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect($winner->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryCustomerStatus::Fixed);
    expect($otherA->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryCustomerStatus::Pending);
    expect($otherB->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryCustomerStatus::Pending);
    expect($enquiry->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryStatus::Completing);
});

test('marking a customer lost only affects that customer', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $enquiry = Enquiry::factory()->create(['status' => EnquiryStatus::Open]);
    $target = $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => 'AAA']);
    $other = $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => 'BBB']);

    $this->patch(route('enquiry-customers.update-status', $target), [
        'status' => 'lost',
    ])->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect($target->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryCustomerStatus::Lost);
    expect($other->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryCustomerStatus::Pending);
    expect($enquiry->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryStatus::Open);
});

test('un-fixing a fixed customer reverts only that customer to pending', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $enquiry = Enquiry::factory()->create(['status' => EnquiryStatus::Open]);
    $winner = $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => 'AAA']);
    $other = $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => 'BBB']);

    $this->patch(route('enquiry-customers.update-status', $winner), ['status' => 'fixed']);

    $this->patch(route('enquiry-customers.update-status', $winner), [
        'status' => 'pending',
    ])->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect($winner->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryCustomerStatus::Pending);
    expect($other->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryCustomerStatus::Pending);
});

test('un-fixing the fixed customer drops the enquiry back to open', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $enquiry = Enquiry::factory()->create(['status' => EnquiryStatus::Open]);
    $winner = $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => 'AAA']);
    $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => 'BBB']);

    $this->patch(route('enquiry-customers.update-status', $winner), ['status' => 'fixed']);
    expect($enquiry->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryStatus::Completing);

    $this->patch(route('enquiry-customers.update-status', $winner), [
        'status' => 'pending',
    ])->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

    expect($enquiry->refresh()->status)->toBe(EnquiryStatus::Open);
});

test('un-losing a lost customer reverts it to pending without touching others', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create());

    $target = $enquiry->enquiryCustomers()->create(['customer_id' => 'AAA', 'status' => EnquiryCustomerStatus::Lost]);

});

test('guests are redirected from the bdns page', function () {
    $this->get(route('bdns.index'))->assertRedirect(route('login'));
});

test('index lists bdns with their order, agent and barge details', function () {
    $this->actingAs(User::factory()->create(['type' => UserType::SuperAdmin]));
